2608.23167.title: Accelerating Diffusion Language Models via Structured Suffix Modeling
2608.23167.paper_summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) exhibit strong parallel decoding capabilities by denoising multiple tokens in a single generation step. However, this parallelism comes with substantial computational overhead, as each step requires interactions with all suffix tokens. Existing methods typically reduce this cost by retaining only a local suffix window as a substitute for the full suffix. Despite their effectiveness, these methods overlook the structural heterogeneity across suffix regions and re-initialize suffix tokens with identical representations at each timestep. To this end, we propose a structured suffix modeling method for efficient DLM inference. Specifically, we divide the suffix into three regions, i.e., the local, middle, and tail regions, and retain different numbers of suffix tokens in each region according to their structural roles. Moreover, we incorporate the decoding results from the previous step into the suffix token representations at the current step, allowing them to carry evolving denoising information across generation steps. Notably, our method is training-free and orthogonal to several existing acceleration techniques, such as parallel decoding strategies and KV cache. Empirical results across multiple benchmarks on three DLMs demonstrate that our method can further accelerate DLM inference and improve performance in most cases. In particular, in long-sequence inference, our method achieves up to a \(72.81\times\) speedup when combined with other acceleration techniques. Our code is available at https://github.com/zifengcheng/SSM.
2608.23167.paper_summary_zh: 擴散語言模型（DLMs）在單次生成步驟中通過去噪多個標記展現出強大的並行解碼能力。<lb/>然而，這種並行性伴隨著相當大的計算開銷，因為每一步都需要與所有後綴標記進行交互。<lb/>現有的方法通常通過僅保留一個局部後綴窗口來減少這一成本，以替代完整的後綴。<lb/>儘管這些方法有效，但它們忽略了後綴區域之間的結構異質性，並在每個時間步重新初始化後綴標記為相同的表示。<lb/>為此，我們提出了一種結構化後綴建模方法，以提高DLM推理的效率。<lb/>具體而言，我們將後綴分為三個區域，即局部區域、中間區域和尾部區域，並根據它們的結構角色在每個區域保留不同數量的後綴標記。<lb/>此外，我們將前一步的解碼結果納入當前步驟的後綴標記表示，使其能夠在生成步驟中攜帶不斷演變的去噪信息。<lb/>值得注意的是，我們的方法是無需訓練的，並且與幾種現有的加速技術（如並行解碼策略和KV緩存）是正交的。<lb/>在三個DLM的多個基準測試中的實證結果顯示，我們的方法可以進一步加速DLM推理，並在大多數情況下提高性能。<lb/>特別是在長序列推理中，我們的方法在與其他加速技術結合時實現了高達 \(72.81\times\) 的加速。<lb/>我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/zifengcheng/SSM 獲得。
